name: edit-tests
wall_rationale: Measured 2026-09-27/28 on llm.selfware.design: 20 completed runs took 164-627 s (p50 ~317 s), including 3 runs with the harness toolchain where the agent's pytest works (216, 337, 351 s; the 351 s one at 14 tok/s, the slowest endpoint rate seen). 1800 s is 2.9x the slowest completed run. The one run that hit 1800 s was a stall (the same pytest command re-run ~10 times after the tests passed), which a longer wall would only prolong.
